title: Thunder vs. Kings: Live updates, highlights for Sunday's game
text:
Thunder vs. Kings: Live updates, highlights for Sunday's game Rumors Stats Odds Betting Newsletter OKC THUNDER Thunder vs. Kings: Live updates, highlights for Sunday's game
 Clemente Almanza OKC Thunder Wire Nov. 15, 2026, 7:00 p.m. CT The Oklahoma City Thunder travel on the road to face the Sacramento Kings on Sunday. This will be the first matchup between the two squads of the 2026-27 regular season.
 The Thunder (8-5) are amid an ultra-rare three-game losing streak — their first since April 2024. They suffered a heartbreaker in a 113-112 loss to the LA Clippers on Friday. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander had an efficient 40 points, but failed to hit the game-winner twice.
 Meanwhile, the Kings (1-11) have lost five in a row. They're easily the worst team in the league. They had a 120-107 loss to the Portland Trail Blazers on Friday. De'Andre Hunter had 24 points and five rebounds. Darius Acuff Jr. dropped an inefficient 17 points.
 For live updates of the Thunder's game against the Kings, please regularly check back to this post:

 Thunder: Jalen Williams (ankle surgery) is out. Cason Wallace (shoulder surgery) is out. Chet Holmgren (knee injury recovery) is out. Jaylin Williams (back spasms) is out. Thomas Sorber (knee surgery) is out.
 Kings: Ben Simmons (torn Achilles tendon) is out. Maxime Raynaud (patella subluxation) is out. Keegan Murray (illness) is questionable. Precious Achiuwa (ankle soreness) is questionable. Jonathan Mogbo (G League two-way) is out. Sean Pedulla (G League two-way) is out.
